title: App Management
meta: We review the apps on your Shopify store, remove what you do not use and update the rest safely. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Shopify app management, reviewed and tidied
overview: Too many apps slow a store and add monthly cost. We list every app on your Shopify store, what it costs, what it does and whether your theme still uses it. We then remove the unused ones the safe way, including leftover theme code, update the ones that need it, and test the pages they touch. You get a one-page app list with costs and our advice on what to keep.

faq: Will removing an app break my store?

We work on a duplicate theme first, remove the app's code there, test it, and only then apply it to the live theme. If something looks risky, we tell you before we touch it, and keep a backup of the theme.
Can you install new apps for me?

Yes, in the Premium package we set up up to two replacements. You pay the app makers directly through your Shopify bill, and we pick apps from the Shopify App Store with a clear privacy and billing record.
Do you see my customer data?
Only what the staff permissions you give us allow. We review which data each app can read and tell you if one asks for more than it needs, so you can decide whether to keep it.
Uninstalling an app in Shopify usually stops its billing, but some apps need you to cancel on their own site. We list those apps and tell you exactly where to cancel, so you stop paying for them.
